blocks.text: The verse of the Qur'aan that kindles the Most Hope According to Hadhrat Ali (RA)

Hadhrat Ali bin Abi Taalib (RA) narrates that Rasulullaah ﷺ once said, "I shall continue interceding on behalf of my Ummah until my Rabb asks, 'Are you now satisfied, O Muhammad?' I shall then say, 'Yes. I am satisfied.' Turning to the people, Hadhrat Ali (RA) said, 'O people of Iraq! Don't you people believe that the verse of the Qur'aan that kindles the most hope is the verse:

blocks.arabic_text: قُلْ يٰعِبَادِيَ الَّذِيْنَ أَسْرَفُوْا عَلٰٓى أَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوْا مِنْ رَّحْمَةِ اللّٰهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ جَمِيْعًا ۚ إِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ
blocks.text: Say, "O My bondsmen who have wronged their souls (by committing kufr or other sins)! Never lose hope of Allaah's mercy (so do not abstain from seeking forgiveness thinking that you will not be forgiven). Verily, Allaah forgives all sins (that are free of kufr and Shirk). Undoubtedly, He is the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful." {Surah Zumar, verse 53}

When the people admitted that they believed so, Hadhrat Ali (RA) said, "However, we who are members of Rasulullaah ﷺ's family believe that the verse of the Qur'aan that kindles the most hope is the verse:
Your Rabb shall soon grant you and you shall be pleased. {Surah Duha, verse 5}
What Allaah will grant Rasulullaah ﷺ shall be the privilege of intercession."[^1]
The Statement of Hadhrat Buraydah (RA) in front of Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA) Concerning Intercession

Hadhrat Ibn Buraydah narrates that (his father) Hadhrat Buraydah (RA) once went to Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA) where a man was busy talking (in praise of Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA)). "Will you permit me to speak, O Mu'aawiya," Hadhrat Buraydah (RA) asked. Thinking that he will also speak as the previous person was doing, Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA) granted him permission. Hadhrat Buraydah (RA) said, "I heard Rasulullaah ﷺ say, 'On the Day of Qiyaamah I expect to intercede on behalf of as many people as there are trees and stones on earth.' You, O Mu'aawiya should pin your hopes in this intercession (because you will need it) while Ali (RA) need not pin his hopes in it (because he will enter Jannah without it)."[^2]
